plan.summary: Adavista pilot omurgasinin INSE-side insanlastirma paketi: (1) message_text node'una hybrid chunk support (text_chunks[] explicit + \n\n auto-split soft opt-in + legacy text fallback) + jittered pre_think + inter_chunk delay formula (MessageChunkPlanner), (2) FAQ post-match lazy translation hook (AiFaqHandler -> TranslationService) + leads.preferred_locale persistence + AiIntentHandler 8 core prompt resource-based i18n (10 dil) + dental vocab warmup ops endpoint. Translation altyapisi (Gemma+Claude dual, 18 dil, hash-cached) mevcut — runtime flow'a baglaniyor. Welcome rotation (HashBasedTemplateRotationService) dokunulmaz. Tone matrix (HFM-3) post-pilot ayri pakete birakildi. Rate limiter ve retry callback path degismez: her chunk ayri OutgoingCallback olarak Outbound'a push edilir. J-TYPE (INMA typing_on) istenmiyor — chunk-arasi jitter 'yaziyor' hissini saglar.
plan.q_intent: 1. Deep Research 'Robot Degil Insan Hissi' (typing indicator simulation, response delay curves, message chunking, natural variation, persona, emoji, turn-taking, WA HSM template constraints). 2. Deep Research FAQ Multi-Language Fallback (language detection, translation quality dental, fallback chain, sessizce dil degisimi, 9 dil support, cache strategy). Plan JSON cikart iki madde icin — ayri ayri veya tek paket. Q karar: (1) tek paket, (2) HFM-3 post-pilot OK, (3) chunk format hybrid, (4) J-TYPE istenmiyor jitter yeterli, (5) preferred_locale FEAT-WTP'den HFM-2'ye devir, (6) dental vocab warmup eklensin.
plan.interview_notes:
Mevcut kod denetimi: Translation altyapisi (TranslationService 18 dil Gemma+Claude dual + DB cache + batch lookup + LanguageDetector 13 dil script-based) PROD-READY ama runtime FAQ pipeline'da cagrilmiyor. Welcome rotation (HashBasedTemplateRotationService FNV-1a deterministik) PROD-READY, dokunulmaz. ActionDelayHandler primitif (sabit seconds, jitter yok). MessageTextHandler tek-balon tek-callback (chunking yok). AiIntentHandler 15+ hardcoded TR cumlesi pilot EN odaklı icin blocker. leads.preferred_locale kolonu yok (FEAT-WTP AC-4 scope'undan devir). MessageSenderService tek-callback-tek-mesaj mimarisi chunking icin uyumlu — her chunk ayri queued_message row (rate limiter + retry korunur).

Chunk format: Q onayli hybrid — engine sirasiyla dener: (1) text_chunks field varsa -> her eleman = 1 balon (explicit kontrol), (2) yoksa text icinde \n\n varsa -> auto-split (soft opt-in), (3) yoksa tek balon (legacy zero-change). Migration gerektirmez, geriye uyumlu.

Delay formula (MessageChunkPlanner): think_delay_ms = clamp(600 + 300*log(msg_length), 600, 1800). inter_chunk_delay_ms = clamp(1200 + 80*chunk_char_count, 1200, 3500). total_cap 8000ms (WA typing_on 25s timeout + UX uzun bekleme riski). Jitter ±15%. Simulation mode delay skip.

Locale fallback chain: lead.preferred_locale -> 'en' -> raw (tenant.locale_default out of scope bu pakette — FEAT-WTP'de eklenebilir ileride).

AiIntent 8 core prompt: greeting, name_retry, intent_ask, confirm, clarify_low, denied, max_attempts_reached, off_hours_redirect. 10 dil: tr/en/ar/ru/de/fr/es/pt/nl/it. IntentPromptLoader singleton ile embedded resource cache.

Dental vocab warmup ops endpoint: POST /ops/translation/warmup?tenantId={id}&intents={list} — 12 intent x 3 variant x 10 dil = 360 string, batch translate, cache populate. Ops-level (X-Ops-Key auth, by design no tenant_id filter). Optional admin-triggered, pilot oncesi 1 kez calistir.

Risk: MEDIUM. Translation latency hot-path (50-150ms per miss; 80% cache hit target). Chunk rate-limiter semantics — chunk_group_id ile tenant quota accounting korunur (her chunk 1 quota slot). HSM template ile chunk etkilesimi: HSM zaten approved-text; INSE freeform ise chunking uygulanir, HSM'de tek-balon kalir (AC-9).

INMA J1/J2/J-HSM/J-WND bu paketten bagimsiz — INSE tarafi lokal iyilestirme, INMA cevabi beklemez. HFM-3 (tone matrix) post-pilot ayri paket. FEAT-WTP AC-4 (preferred_locale) bu pakette teslim edildigi icin FEAT-WTP'den scope dusulur (FEAT-WTP spec'e not).

acceptance_criteria.criterion:
MessageTextHandler.cs: hybrid chunk resolution sirasiyla: (1) node.data.text_chunks (JSON array string) varsa -> Parse edip her eleman bir chunk, (2) yoksa node.data.text icinde '

' varsa -> Split('

', RemoveEmptyEntries) auto-split, (3) yoksa tek chunk (legacy). Invalid text_chunks JSON durumunda logger.SystemWarn('[INV-AT-062] ...') + legacy text fallback. Degiskenler (variant_index/variant_count) korunur — text_variants + text_chunks birlikte kullanilirsa: once variant pick, sonra chunk split uygulanir.

Invekto.Shared/Services/MessageChunkPlanner.cs (YENI): PlanChunks(string[] chunks) metodu ChunkSchedule (List<ChunkStep>) dondurur. ChunkStep = { string Text, int PreDelayMs }. Formula: preThink = clamp(600 + 300*Math.Log(firstChunk.Length+1), 600, 1800). interChunk[i] = clamp(1200 + 80*chunks[i].Length, 1200, 3500). Jitter: Random.Shared ile ±15% (seed non-determ OK — delay trace-only). Total cap: sum(preDelays) <= 8000ms, fazla ise proportional azalt. Unit testable: Random inject edilebilir (ITimeJitter interface optional, simple constructor-injected Func<double, double>).

AutomationOrchestrator: v2 path'te MessageTextHandler chunked MessageText dondurdugunde (yeni ChunkedResult = { ChunkSchedule, VariableUpdates }) orchestrator her step icin (Task.Delay(step.PreDelayMs) -> SendCallbackAsync(step.Text, ct)) sirasiyla yapar. IsSimulation=true ise Task.Delay skip + log 'chunk i/N simulate'. Chunk-arasi cancellation honored (CancellationToken propagate). Her callback ayri OutgoingCallback (RequestId + chunk_group_id + chunk_index dahil). Sequence preserving.

arch/db/migrations/018-leads-preferred-locale.sql: ALTER TABLE leads ADD COLUMN preferred_locale VARCHAR(5). CHECK (preferred_locale IS NULL OR preferred_locale ~ '^[a-z]{2}(-[A-Z]{2})?$'). CREATE INDEX idx_leads_preferred_locale ON leads(tenant_id, preferred_locale) WHERE preferred_locale IS NOT NULL. Backfill SAFE: existing rows NULL kalir (translation fallback 'en' veya raw olur, AC7 chain). Migration idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS).

AutomationOrchestrator.ProcessMessageAsync: ilk inbound mesajda LanguageDetector.Detect(messageText) + (length>=5 ise Backend TranslationService.DetectLanguageAsync) combined -> preferred_locale upsert (AutomationRepository.UpsertLeadPreferredLocaleAsync). Sticky: eger mevcut preferred_locale varsa DEGISMEZ (manual override kullanici aksi belirtmedikce). Race guvenli: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, phone) DO UPDATE SET preferred_locale = COALESCE(leads.preferred_locale, EXCLUDED.preferred_locale) — existing value korunur.

AiFaqHandler.MatchAndRoute: matched answer dondurmeden once target locale resolve et: var lead = await _repo.GetLeadByPhoneAsync(tenantId, ctx.ContactKey) -> preferred = lead?.PreferredLocale. IF preferred != null AND answer.language != preferred -> TranslationService.TranslateAsync (via IHttpClient to Backend:5000/api/v1/translate) -> translated. IF translation fails (HttpRequestException/timeout) -> log error + send original answer (graceful degradation). Translation hop ekler ~50-150ms (cache hit 80%+ hedef).

AiFaqHandler locale fallback chain: (1) lead.preferred_locale varsa onu kullan, (2) yoksa 'en' default, (3) answer zaten 'en' ise translate skip, (4) translation service unreachable ise raw answer. Her level'de log: 'locale_resolved: source=lead|default|en, target={lang}, skip=true|false'. AiIntent low-confidence fallback yok (intent akisi lang-agnostic kalir, sadece prompt text i18n).

AiIntentHandler 8 core prompt resource-based: Invekto.Automation/Resources/IntentPrompts.{tr,en,ar,ru,de,fr,es,pt,nl,it}.json (10 dosya, JSON schema: { greeting: string, name_retry: string, intent_ask: string, confirm: string, clarify_low: string, denied: string, max_attempts_reached: string, off_hours_redirect: string }). Placeholder: {name}, {summary}. Invekto.Automation.csproj embed resource. IntentPromptLoader singleton cache (lazy load per-locale, ConcurrentDictionary). AiIntentHandler hardcoded string'ler _promptLoader.Get(locale, key, substitutions) ile degistirilir. Locale resolution: lead.preferred_locale -> 'tr' default (mevcut davranis korunur, non-Adavista tenant'lar etkilenmez).

Backend /ops/translation/warmup endpoint (POST): body { tenantId, intents: string[], locales: string[] }. Ops-level auth (X-Ops-Key), by design no tenant JWT (documented cross-tenant admin intentional_exclusion). Flow: for each (intent, locale): Knowledge'dan FAQ answers fetch -> TranslationService.TranslateBatchAsync -> cache populate. Response: { translatedCount, cacheHits, apiCalls, durationMs }. Dent pilot oncesi: POST /ops/translation/warmup?tenantId=<dent_id>&intents=price,location,safety,xray,...&locales=en,ar,de,fr,es,pt,nl,it,tr (ru disinda 8 dil; EN primary zaten raw).
